answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 34906 Country: India Title: I have no job or any rozgar from last 2 years Question: I have no job or any rozgar from last 2 years. I have no source of income and I feel very bad sometime. I am in a very big worry after 1 month my sister is going to get married also. Alhamdulillah, I offer salah regularly. I tried for job or to start small business but there is no success. Please tell me any dua that help me for being wealthy. Answer ID: 34906 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1662/1139/L=1432) You along with all your family members should recite Sura Waqiyah after Maghrib salah. Also recite يا مغنى 1111 times after Isha salah with durood 11-11 times before and after. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
